_comment: MCP pipeline integration test fixtures. The 'aa-' prefix forces alphabetic load order ahead of anthropic-image-gen.json, whose turn-1 fixture matches on {turnIndex, hasToolResult} only and would otherwise win against this test's tool_result turn. Our turn-1 fixture's toolName filter scopes us to requests where mcp__echotest__echo is registered, so we never accidentally win against the image-gen test (whose tools list doesn't include it).
